inv.desc_en: Discover this new commercial space located in the coveted La Princesa-Huelin area of Málaga. With a constructed area of 219 m2 and 203 m2 of usable space, this property is specially designed to meet the needs of clinics or companies that require several functional rooms. The space includes an area intended for meetings equipped with a kitchen, perfect for comfortably serving clients and staff. Its north-facing orientation ensures natural light throughout the day while keeping it cool in the warmer months. Also enjoy the competitive rent for only €2990 per month; it also has an accessible initial premium of €30,000. Do not forget to consider the corresponding annual trash fee of €114! This property has no double or single bedrooms but offers all the necessary amenities within its single bathroom. Take advantage of this exceptional opportunity: your business deserves the best.
